title: Constraint: Conditional Probability
constraints: When `mode = 1`: `len` is in 8 … 15, and `len = 15` in half of those cases. When `mode = 0`: `len` is in 0 … 7.
Statistics are measured over 1000 calls with a tolerance of about ±6 %.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: `:=` gives each value the weight, `:/` divides the weight across a range: `len dist {15 := 50, [8:14] :/ 50};` gives 15 half the probability.
